title: Apply for a design right
summary: This page provides information about design rights, which protect the overall visual appearance of new and distinctive products.
intro:
A design is the overall appearance of a product, and includes shape, configuration, pattern and/or ornamentation.

A design right protects the overall visual appearance of new and distinctive products.
